This cement bag is ………………….

 This ratio is ………………….

The correct depth of the foundation is 1.5 metres. This foundation is 1 metre.

 This foundation is ………………….

The standard curing time for concrete is 28 days. The curing time here is 20 days.

This curing time is ………………….

The safe load for scaffolding is 200 kilograms. This load is 250 kilograms.

This load is ………………….

The recommended thickness of a brick wall is 23 centimeters. This wall is 18 centimeters.

This wall is ………………….

The correct length of steel reinforcement is 10 metres. This steel bar is 11 metres.

This steel bar is ………………….

The acceptable slump for concrete is 75–100 millimetres. This slump is 120 millimetres.

 This slump is ………………….

The standard width of a doorway is 90 centimeters. This doorway is 80 centimeters.

 This doorway is ………………….
